# Mirakl Marketplace APIs

{% partial file="/partial-content/product/mmp/rest/seller/openapi-description.md" /%}

## Servers
- https://your-instance.mirakl.net — URL to be replaced by your Mirakl instance URL

## Authentication
- Shop-API-Key: API key in header "Authorization"

## Dates and times
date (22 fields), date-time (239 fields), time (1 fields); date-time is RFC 3339 (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)
